entries.title: Isaiah 5:1
segments: ¶Now let me sing to my Well-beloved A song of my Beloved regarding His vineyard: My Well-beloved has a vineyard On a very fruitful hill.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:2
segments: He dug it up and cleared out its stones, And planted it with the choicest vine. He built a tower in its midst, And also made a winepress in it; So He expected [it] to bring forth [good] grapes, But it brought forth wild grapes.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:3
segments: "And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, Judge, please, between Me and My vineyard.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:4
segments: What more could have been done to My vineyard That I have not done in it? Why then, when I expected [it] to bring forth [good] grapes, Did it bring forth wild grapes?

entries.title: Isaiah 5:5
segments: And now, please let Me tell you what I will do to My vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it shall be burned; [And] break down its wall, and it shall be trampled down.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:6
segments: I will lay it waste; It shall not be pruned or dug, But there shall come up briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds That they rain no rain on it."

entries.title: Isaiah 5:7
segments: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts [is] the house of Israel, And the men of Judah are His pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression; For righteousness, but behold, a cry [for help].

entries.title: Isaiah 5:8
segments: ¶Woe to those who join house to house; They add field to field, Till [there is] no place Where they may dwell alone in the midst of the land!

entries.title: Isaiah 5:9
segments: In my hearing the LORD of hosts [said], "Truly, many houses shall be desolate, Great and beautiful ones, without inhabitant.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:10
segments: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, And a homer of seed shall yield one ephah."

entries.title: Isaiah 5:11
segments: Woe to those who rise early in the morning, [That] they may follow intoxicating drink; Who continue until night, [till] wine inflames them!

entries.title: Isaiah 5:12
segments: The harp and the strings, The tambourine and flute, And wine are in their feasts; But they do not regard the work of the LORD, Nor consider the operation of His hands.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:13
segments: Therefore my people have gone into captivity, Because [they have] no knowledge; Their honorable men [are] famished, And their multitude dried up with thirst.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:14
segments: Therefore Sheol has enlarged itself And opened its mouth beyond measure; Their glory and their multitude and their pomp, And he who is jubilant, shall descend into it.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:15
segments: People shall be brought down, Each man shall be humbled, And the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:16
segments: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, And God who is holy shall be hallowed in righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:17
segments: Then the lambs shall feed in their pasture, And in the waste places of the fat ones strangers shall eat.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:18
segments: ¶Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of vanity, And sin as if with a cart rope;

entries.title: Isaiah 5:19
segments: That say, "Let Him make speed [and] hasten His work, That we may see [it]; And let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, That we may know [it]."

entries.title: Isaiah 5:20
segments: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; Who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; Who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

entries.title: Isaiah 5:21
segments: Woe to [those who are] wise in their own eyes, And prudent in their own sight!

entries.title: Isaiah 5:22
segments: Woe to men mighty at drinking wine, Woe to men valiant for mixing intoxicating drink,

entries.title: Isaiah 5:23
segments: Who justify the wicked for a bribe, And take away justice from the righteous man!

entries.title: Isaiah 5:24
segments: Therefore, as the fire devours the stubble, And the flame consumes the chaff, [So] their root will be as rottenness, And their blossom will ascend like dust; Because they have rejected the law of the LORD of hosts, And despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:25
segments: Therefore the anger of the LORD is aroused against His people; He has stretched out His hand against them And stricken them, And the hills trembled. Their carcasses [were] as refuse in the midst of the streets. For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand [is] stretched out still.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:26
segments: He will lift up a banner to the nations from afar, And will whistle to them from the end of the earth; Surely they shall come with speed, swiftly.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:27
segments: No one will be weary or stumble among them, No one will slumber or sleep; Nor will the belt on their loins be loosed, Nor the strap of their sandals be broken;

entries.title: Isaiah 5:28
segments: Whose arrows [are] sharp, And all their bows bent; Their horses' hooves will seem like flint, And their wheels like a whirlwind.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:29
segments: Their roaring [will be] like a lion, They will roar like young lions; Yes, they will roar And lay hold of the prey; They will carry [it] away safely, And no one will deliver.

entries.title: Isaiah 5:30
segments: In that day they will roar against them Like the roaring of the sea. And if [one] looks to the land, Behold, darkness [and] sorrow; And the light is darkened by the clouds.
